title: Adding Combat To My Game
author: Casanova_pua
selftext:
Hello! I am building a space MMO online RPG, kinda like Runescape. I recently added combat into my game, please let me know what you all think!

All questions will be answered in comments.

I've utilised AI in a lot of the frontend graphics we see, however the usage for AI for me is very small task orientated. Because i'm serious about this project AI has been doing bit by by with my guidance so i can retain code quality. The backend for this game was incredibly robust in terms of architecture. 

AI played very little role in the core architecture. Backend is entirely in Java, and the frontend is in React + Three.JS. 

This front end would never have been possible without AI. The backend would (because i've been a software engineer for 18 years and worked on games for 7 years now, backend).
